summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns detailing an ongoing share repurchase program. For the period April 1–17, 2026, the company repurchased approximately 13.77 million Class A ordinary shares at prices ranging from USD 4.92 to USD 5.50 per share. These shares are held as treasury stock pending cancellation. The buybacks represent a capital return to shareholders, reducing outstanding share count. No board recommendation or financial advisor is mentioned. The filing is a routine disclosure of open-market repurchases under a previously authorized program. Watch for continued buyback pace and cancellation progress.
